snippet.title: Cannon Keep Updated Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3755200/
Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4437800/
